title: A Wave From It All | KEY.co
description_expanded: Discover a serene escape where the charm of a beach house meets the sophistication of modern living. This polished residence is an ode to coastal elegance, inviting guests to unwind in an environment where every detail reflects a love for the sea and sand. From the moment you step inside, you're greeted by delightful coastal decor that adorns each room, creating a warm and welcoming atmosphere. The heart of the home boasts an enormous open kitchen equipped with a prep island, full-size appliances, and an array of culinary tools ready to assist in creating delicious meals. For those who prefer their vacation fare with a bit more zest, the backyard offers a private flat top grill perfect for outdoor cooking adventures. Central air conditioning ensures comfort throughout the house, making every space a cool retreat from the summer heat. Beyond the allure of its interior, this dog-friendly home caters to every guest's need for relaxation and convenience. The splendid main bedroom on the lower level features a spacious layout, complete with a luxurious ensuite bathroom that houses a standalone shower, offering a private sanctuary for rest and rejuvenation. Each bedroom, with its unique decor, offers a personalized haven, ensuring that everyone finds their perfect spot to relax. The community pool beckons with the promise of refreshing dips, while the custom coffee bar inside promises to start your mornings on a high note. With the beach always within easy reach, this home isn't just a place to stay; it's a gateway to a blissful coastal experience where leisure and luxury beautifully intertwine.

Features: Use of charcoal grills is not allowed.
